script_en:
# REINVENT4 Tutorial 02 — Your Prior Is an Experiment — Prove It

Target: ~8:00

## [0:00–0:15 Hook]
Tutorial 01 gave you reinvent_pubchem.prior. Downloading it was not a research decision. This episode is.

## [0:15–1:15 Will it cover your chemistry?]
Official docs list prior filenames. Lab work asks: will this generative starting point cover the chemistry you care about? If your project is sulfonamide-rich — or macrocycles, peptides, covalent warheads — and the prior almost never emits that motif, RL burns its first hours rediscovering it. Or never finds it.

## [1:15–2:20 Fair A/B]
Many Zenodo files are different generators (Mol2Mol, LibInvent) — different tasks. Keep the Reinvent generator fixed; change only weights. Compare reinvent_pubchem.prior vs tl_sulfonamide.model (8 TL epochs on sulfonamides).

## [2:20–3:50 Identical protocol]
CPU. Seed 42. ~200 SMILES. unique_molecules on. TOMLs differ only in model_file / output_file. Demo TL: ~13 s, ~871 MiB peak. After uniqueness: 191 vs 196 rows — expected.

## [3:50–5:30 The numbers]
SMARTS S(=O)(=O)N. Sulfonamide %: 8.4% → 64.3%. Murcko scaffolds: 168 vs 172. Mean QED 0.59 → 0.65 (side effect). Short TL enriched the motif without scaffold collapse in this seed-42 draw.

## [5:30–6:45 Decision table]
Prior OK → Tutorial 03. TL helps → use checkpoint for RL. Need linkers/R-groups/seed analogues → wrong generator. Peptides/exotics → check tokens / Pepinvent.

## [6:45–8:00 CTA]
Compare → measure → decide → then RL. Full tutorial on the site. Code on GitHub.
script_zh:
# REINVENT4 教程 02 — Prior 是实验选择——用数据证明

目标时长：约 8:00

## [0:00–0:15 开场]
教程 01 给了你 reinvent_pubchem.prior。下载它不是研究决策。这一期才是。

## [0:15–1:15 覆盖你的化学吗？]
实验室要问：生成起点覆盖你关心的化学吗？磺酰胺 / 大环 / 肽 / 共价 warhead 若在 prior 里极稀，RL 会浪费前期算力。

## [1:15–2:20 公平 A/B]
不同 Zenodo 文件可能是不同生成器。固定 Reinvent，只换权重：prior vs tl_sulfonamide.model（磺酰胺上 8 epoch TL）。

## [2:20–3:50 同一协议]
CPU、seed 42、约 200 SMILES、unique_molecules。只改 model_file。演示 TL ≈13 s / ~871 MiB。去重后 191 vs 196 行。

## [3:50–5:30 数字]
S(=O)(=O)N：8.4% → 64.3%。Murcko：168 vs 172。QED 0.59 → 0.65（副作用）。

## [5:30–6:45 决策表]
Prior 够用 → 教程 03；TL 有效 → 用作 RL 起点；要连接子/R 基/种子类似物 → 换生成器。

## [6:45–8:00 CTA]
对比→度量→决策→再 RL。网站完整教程 + GitHub 代码。
voiceover_en:
Tutorial 01 gave you reinvent_pubchem.prior. Downloading it was not a research decision. This episode is.

Official docs list prior filenames. Lab work asks: will this generative starting point cover the chemistry you care about? If your project is sulfonamide-rich — or macrocycles, peptides, covalent warheads — and the prior almost never emits that motif, reinforcement learning burns its first hours rediscovering it. Or never finds it.

Many Zenodo files are different generators — Mol2Mol, LibInvent — different tasks. A fair test keeps the Reinvent generator fixed and changes only the weights. So we compare reinvent_pubchem.prior against a short transfer-learning checkpoint: tl_sulfonamide.model, fine-tuned eight epochs on sulfonamides. Same architecture. New distribution.

Protocol is the science. CPU. Seed 42. About two hundred SMILES each. Unique molecules on. Two config files that differ only in model file and output file. Transfer learning on this demo set finished in about thirteen seconds and peaked near 871 megabytes of RAM. After uniqueness you get slightly fewer than 200 rows — 191 versus 196 in the handbook run. That is expected.

Score the decision with RDKit. SMARTS: S equals O twice N. PubChem prior: 8.4 percent sulfonamide hits. After short transfer learning: 64.3 percent. Unique Murcko scaffolds stay high — 168 versus 172. Mean QED moves from 0.59 to 0.65 as a side effect, not the goal. Short transfer learning shifted token preference toward the sulfonamide motif without collapsing scaffold diversity in this seed-42 draw.

What next? If the prior already hits your SMARTS at an acceptable rate, stay on PubChem and go score in Tutorial 03. If the prior rarely hits and transfer learning enriches without killing scaffolds, use that checkpoint as your starting agent or prior for reinforcement learning. Need linkers, R-groups, or analogue-by-seed? Wrong generator — not more PubChem epochs. Peptides or exotic elements: check token support.

Priors are experimental choices. Compare under one protocol. Measure chemotype hit rate and scaffolds. Decide with evidence before you burn reinforcement-learning compute. Full commands, configs, and CSVs are on the AI Drug Discovery Lab site. Code lives on GitHub. Link in the description — pick a prior on purpose.
voiceover_zh:
教程 01 给了你 reinvent_pubchem.prior。下载它不是研究决策。这一期才是。

官方文档列 prior 文件名。实验室要问：这个生成起点，覆盖你关心的化学吗？若项目富含磺酰胺，或大环、肽、共价 warhead，而 prior 几乎从不吐出该基序，强化学习会把最初几小时浪费在重新发现上，甚至永远找不到。

许多 Zenodo 文件是不同生成器，Mol2Mol、LibInvent，任务本就不同。公平对比要固定 Reinvent 生成器，只改权重。于是我们对比 reinvent_pubchem.prior 与短迁移学习检查点 tl_sulfonamide.model：在磺酰胺上微调 8 个 epoch。同一架构，新的分布。

协议才是科学。CPU。Seed 42。各约 200 条 SMILES。打开 unique molecules。两份配置只改模型文件与输出文件。演示集上的迁移学习约 13 秒完成，峰值内存约 871 兆。去重后略少于 200 行，手册运行是 191 对 196。这是预期现象。

用 RDKit 给决策打分。SMARTS：S(=O)(=O)N。PubChem prior：磺酰胺命中 8.4%。短迁移学习之后：64.3%。独特 Murcko 骨架仍然很高，168 对 172。平均 QED 从 0.59 到 0.65，这是副作用，不是目标。短迁移学习把偏好推向磺酰胺基序，在本次 seed 42 抽样里没有压垮骨架多样性。

下一步？若 prior 已以可接受频率命中你的 SMARTS，留下 PubChem，去做教程 03 的评分。若 prior 很少命中、而迁移学习富集且不毁骨架，就把该检查点当作强化学习的起始 agent 或 prior。需要连接子、R 基团或按种子找类似物？生成器选错了，不是再训更多 PubChem epoch。肽或奇特元素：检查 token 支持。

Prior 是实验选择。同一协议下对比。度量化学型命中率与骨架。在烧掉强化学习算力前用证据决策。完整命令、配置与 CSV 在 AI Drug Discovery Lab 网站。代码在 GitHub。描述栏有链接。有意识地选 prior。
